LanguageData.LP_WS_MindSpiked.description: The caster's mind is pinned to its mind: can't turn invisible.

LanguageData.LP_WS_Blink.description: Flickering back and forth between this plane and the Ethereal Plane: each enemy attack has a 50% chance to miss.
